name: Vibrant Thorns
text:
Your body sprouts a coat of brambly thorns that thrive on life magic. Adjacent creatures that hit you with a melee attack, as well as creatures that hit you with unarmed attacks, take @item.rank piercing damage each time they do. Anytime you cast a vitality spell, the thorns' damage increases to @item.rankd6 piercing until the start of your next turn.

---

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1, or 1d6 after you cast a vitality spell.
